text:
maya: Heads up — noticed a small but recurring class of permission drift after the RBAC role-refactor we shipped yesterday. Several users remain in admin-equivalent groups even after SCIM deprovision events. :eyes:
ben: ack, can you paste an example user or group ID and a quick timeline?
maya: example extId: usr-7f3b, group: infra-admins. SCIM logs show deprovision PATCH at 2230011200 but KMS grants still present for kms-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789:role/redwood-provisioner-g-7f3b. Audit shows no revoke.
carol: that's worrying — could be the provisioner tombstone / reconciliation window not clearing related service principals. Did the deprov API return 200 or 202?
maya: returned 200; body: `{ "status": "deprovisioned", "tombstone": "ttl=72h" }`. But DB reconciliation job spikes later and re-creates a membership due to a race with the new inheritance logic.
dave: quick check — I ran this query on the sync DB: `select * from scim_memberships where ext_id='usr-7f3b' and deleted_at is null;` it returned a phantom row with last_sync=2230011305. Means reconcile re-wrote it.
oncall-sre: seeing related alert: `provisioner.reconcile.error` at 2230011320 for tenant t-998. stack: NullParentRole -> fallback create.
ben: could the RBAC refactor changed role canonical IDs so the provisioner fallback created an implicit mapping? We introduced `role_v2` with aliasing last week.
carol: yes — aliasing code had `if not found -> create placeholder-role` which is exactly the behavior. That placeholder ends up linked to KMS-grant flow, so the KMS principal is provisioned and never revoked on subsequent deprovs.
maya: here's a snippet from the provisioner log (redacted):
```
INFO 2230011290 provisioner: reconcile membership missing parent -> create placeholder role id=ph-4321
INFO 2230011291 kms: create grant principal=arn:aws:iam::123456789:role/redwood-provisioner-ph-4321 grant_id=g-99877
INFO 2230011306 reconcile: applied membership for user=usr-7f3b group=infra-admins
```
ben: thanks. So root cause: role-alias fallback + reconcile race => phantom membership + dangling KMS grant.
carol: short-term mitigation: stop reconcile job for affected shards and revoke grants manually for known grant_ids. I can run an automated revoke: `aws kms retire-grant --grant-id g-99877 --key-id alias/redwood-provisioner` after we confirm.
dave: manual revoke confirmed safe? we should ensure no live workflows depend on that principal. run `aws sts get-caller-identity --role-arn arn:...` check last-used.
oncall-sre: I've added a temporary runbook step and muted reconcile for t-998 at 2230011350.
maya: opened INC-2023-4895 for the incident and a follow-up ticket PLAT-3471 to change the fallback behavior.
ben: long-term fix options: 1) remove create-placeholder in alias path and fail reconcile so membership nukes fully; 2) ensure placeholder roles are created with short TTL and are automatically garbage-collected and cascade-revokes to KMS; 3) add a post-deprov hook that verifies KMS principals for the tenant and revokes unmatched grants.
carol: I prefer 2 + 3. TTL+garbage-collection is safer than failing production reconciles. Also add an audit alert: if deprov event occurs but KMS grant count doesn't decrease within 10m, fire `security.kms.drift` alert.
dave: I'll prototype a garbage-collector that polls `placeholder_roles` and runs `kms retire-grant` plus `iam delete-role` for staled placeholders.
oncall-sre: tagging infra-oncall to review planned pause windows. @oncall-sre can coordinate?
oncall-sre: I'll schedule a 30m maintenance window at 2230013000 and notify affected tenants.
ben: we should also add an audit query to backfill — list all principals created by placeholder roles since 2230000000 and revoke or mark for manual review. I'll open PLAT-3472.
maya: one more ask: someone from security to add this scenario to the monthly vuln triage — placeholder roles leading to indefinite KMS principals = high-risk.
carol: adding to triage board and will include suggested detection queries for CloudTrail: `EventName=CreateGrant AND PrincipalName like 'redwood-provisioner-ph-%'`
dave: quick checklist for remediation (short):
- mute reconcile on affected shards (done)
- backfill and revoke grants (in progress)
- patch provisioner alias fallback (PLAT-3471)
- GC + TTL for placeholders (work in progress)
- post-deprov KMS verification alert (PLAT-3473)
- postmortem + customer outreach draft (maya)
maya: thanks team. I'll draft the customer outreach and include exact safe-phrases. If anyone has extra evidence (other user IDs, grant IDs) paste here. :thumbsup:
security-bot: Incident INC-2023-4895 created and linked to PLAT-3471, PLAT-3472, PLAT-3473. Assigned to carol, ben, dave.
ben: dropping grant id g-99877 and g-99891 into PLAT-3472 now.
carol: updating the reconciler PR to avoid create-on-miss; will send for review in ~45m.
maya: solid. ping me when revoke is done so I can validate audit trails.
